summary: Corrected a false premise in my own observed-behavior knowledge entry rather than letting it stand: while preparing the aftermath probe I found that in the quorum harness the term-2 entry appended by leader 1 was never replicated to the followers (the extended harness shows the new leader appending with prev=(index=10, term=1)), so that entry was uncommitted and was not part of any prefix I compared. The entry is revised under its existing id with changed_premise, its receipt-backed observations (accepted peer-form MsgForgetLeader at index 13, granted pre-vote 14, granted vote 15, candidate StateLeader at term 3 index 17, incumbent still StateLeader at term 2 index 18, restore at 7/8) left untouched, and affected_uses left empty because no recorded use exists. Incomplete: the extended aftermath harness still needs its commit-progress measurement inspected (the new leader's commit stayed at 10 after the incumbent's append response instead of advancing), so it was not filed as an experiment this turn.
